question: What practice concerning the soul has been told to the addressed goddess, and by what act of disclosure is it presented?
premises: This practice of the soul is indicated.
It has been told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: Content of the practice not detailed in this verse
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
